page.overview:
Who is Cranky Kong?

Cranky Kong is a supporting character in The Super Mario Bros. Movie. He is the ruler of the Jungle Kingdom.

Cranky Kong's appearance resembles his video game counterpart. However, he is shown wearing emperor-like attire unlike his video game counterpart.

Cranky Kong is known for his bluntness and his refusal to make alliances. Later on, he showed concern when his fellow primates were captured by Bowser's army.

Cranky Kong resided in the Jungle Kingdom.
